comparison: Against the matched control, energy changes mass TV .175212 to .053385 on anisotropic and blobs from three modes/.8125 clean to four modes/.96875 clean. Rare support is retained but rare shape fails sustained checks; overlap improves to twenty of twenty-four complete checks but retains mean jitter and suffix one. Bars gains a mode while losing cleanliness. All three native precision/shape gates still fail.
conclusion: Two of eleven original failures repaired under complete unchanged gates: vector_anisotropic and img_blobs4. Six of fifteen tasks PASS, nine FAIL, with all four regression controls retained. This is a partial diagnostic gain, not a complete global repair.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: A direct normalized energy-distance witness on the existing G-phase batches repairs generated component allocation without changing prior policy, sampling or tasks.
next_action: Stop this exact revision as a global replacement. Retain its two sustained repairs and saved artifacts; isolate rare-shape instability, mean jitter and local image detail before any separately declared successor. No coefficient or seed sweep, continuation or default adoption.

study.competing_explanation: A global energy distance can underweight small local shape defects; output attraction/repulsion can conflict with adversarial direction protection or regress acquisition.
